prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1055; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, low back pain, and stiffness with restricted range of motion. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness in the cervical and lumbar regions, decreased cervical rotation, and guarding with forward flexion of the lumbar spine. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no radicular symptoms reported. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red-flag findings.

Over the course of care the patient completed 18 visits consisting of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, posture education, and home exercise program instruction. Pain levels and range of motion improved steadily across the treatment period, and the patient reported progressive reduction in functional limitations with daily activities and work duties.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full cervical and lumbar range of motion with minimal residual tenderness. Remaining symptoms are intermittent and related to prolonged positioning. The patient was instructed to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsen. Prognosis for full recovery is good.
